# Paper figure — DNABERT-2 workflow transfer (three panels)

**Status: canonical.** Controls `DBP1`/`DBP3`/`DBP4` (A), `DBP8` (B), `DBP7` (C). Generated by
`scripts/dnabert_promoter/make_paper_figure_transfer.py` for the workshop manuscript.

**Why this figure exists.** The manuscript previously carried a hand-composited three-panel figure
with no generator and no provenance sidecar. Its panel-B signal bars had drifted from the artifact
its own legend named — plotted `+0.721` and `+0.651` against recorded means of `+0.8793` and
`+0.8429`, while the two control bars matched — so the bars, the caption, and the body text
disagreed with each other and nothing in the repository could see it. Every number here is read
from a frozen artifact at render time and re-checked against that artifact before it reaches an
axis; the generator aborts rather than draw a value it cannot source.

**A.** Masked-mean linear probe fitted independently at each of the 12 encoder layer outputs,
frozen encoder throughout. Layer 2 is the validation argmax. **Read the flatness, not the peak** —
the early layers are separated by `0.0019` on a single seed, so this supports "promoter information
is linearly recoverable early and does not improve with depth", not "layer 2 is the promoter layer"
(`DBPR2`). Annotated test metrics (BA `0.8102`, ROC-AUC `0.8919`) are descriptive; the test split
took no part in selection.

**B.** Layer-2 activation transplant for the `L0 MLP + L0H8` component set on the untouched test
cohort, n=128. The contrast that matters is matched source versus unrelated same class: `+0.8793`
versus `+0.8429`, a difference of `+0.0364` at Wilcoxon raw `p = 0.25` (Holm-adjusted `0.25`).
**It is null before correction, not merely after it** — the transplant carries class-level
information, not example-specific information. The class contrast is overwhelming by comparison
(`+0.8429` versus `-0.1516`, raw p underflowing in the artifact). Only the `L0_MLP_L0H8` set is
drawn; the companion `L0_MLP` set is in `figure12_test_component_transplant_matrix`, which this
figure does not supersede.

**C.** Mean standalone faithfulness as nodes are added in ranked order, every node outside the
circuit ablated, validation and test at n=128 each. **There is no knee.** The two jumps are MLP
additions, located from the artifact's own `num_mlps` column rather than hard-coded, which is why
the computation is described as MLP-dominated rather than head-carried. Read with Figure 10: the
same five nodes deliver `0.882` of the corruption effect *conditionally* under patching and `0.194`
standing alone. Conflating those two numbers produced the withdrawn "compact confirmed component
set" language (`DBPR4`).

**Scope.** This figure supports *workflow* transfer — the same interventions run, and returned
interpretable answers, in a second model. It does not support mechanism correspondence with
SpliceBERT. One seed, no preregistration, no calibration pair, no matched-size component nulls, and
a cohort selected by corruption damage.
